1. Remove the "Library intake begins" box as it is redundant.
2. Correct the arrow direction from "Receive donated book" to "Inspect book".
3. Ensure all boxes are distinct and not overlapping.
4. Make sure the text in the "Library intake complete" box is clear and readable.

Visible labels involved: Library intake begins, Receive donated book, Inspect book, Assign catalogue number, Attach shelf label, Place book on shelf, Library intake complete.
